# Prompt Contract

## Output Format Contract
- Required sections/headings, ordering, and text constraints.

## Decision Policy
- Classification logic and precedence.

## Defang and Safety Rules
- URL handling and risky-content constraints.

## Variant Strategy
- How to create and evolve `prompts/variants/variant-XXX.md`.

## Non-Goals
- What prompt logic should not include.
